note: Greene County AL parcel layer 'Parcels - AL - Greene County' (GreeneAL FeatureServer, owner GDITAdmin; also an sstelly copy) is listed publicly with a Greene County-matching extent, but every REST request (services, layer 0, layer 5, FeatureServer root) returns 'Item does not exist or is inaccessible' (CONT_0001). Other searches (ArcGIS Hub/Online for Greene County AL parcels, Alabama parcels, neighbouring Tuscaloosa and Sumter) found no other county parcel service; the county website host was unreachable. Only a third-party Regrid nationwide layer exists, which is not county-published and whose query endpoint returns 404.
